name: Locate the file
description: Shows the playing track's file, or the tracks chosen, in Finder, Tandem or your own file manager

settings.label: Open in
settings.help: System default: Finder on macOS, the file chosen; elsewhere the desktop's file manager. Tandem: its folder in Tandem.

settings.label: My own command
settings.help: Run with sh when Open in is My own command: {} is the file, {folder} its folder, and without either the folder is added at the end, as open -a ForkLift {folder}

settings.label: Music folder here
settings.help: Only for an engine on another computer whose music folder is somewhere else here: its folder = this computer's, as /srv/music=/Volumes/music; several separated by ;
